description: Find and rank evidence-backed hiring contacts for a pasted job posting, using available research tools.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find relevant hiring contacts for the job posting I paste. Rank people credibly tied to the company, team, role, or university recruiting, with evidence and profile links. Use an appropriate connected research app if available; offer approval before any required installation or connection, otherwise use an honest available fallback. Do not contact anyone without my approval.
interface.longDescription: Paste a job posting to find relevant team members, role recruiters, and university recruiters. Receive a concise ranked brief with evidence, profile links, confidence, and clear limitations. Uses appropriate connected research apps or available public web research; requests approval before new connections and never initiates outreach without explicit approval.

name: hiring-contact-finder
